# sherpa-barchart

A vertical bar chart for categorical comparison.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | chart |
| Figma | Data Field |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-barchart/sherpa-barchart.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-barchart/sherpa-barchart.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-barchart/sherpa-barchart.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-barchart/sherpa-barchart.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-barchart/sherpa-barchart.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-container><sherpa-data-viz-header slot="header" data-heading="Customers by plan"></sherpa-data-viz-header><sherpa-barchart></sherpa-barchart></sherpa-container>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-barchart`:

```json
[
  {
    "label": "Pro",
    "value": 12,
    "colorIndex": 1
  },
  {
    "label": "Team",
    "value": 8,
    "colorIndex": 2
  },
  {
    "label": "Free",
    "value": 3,
    "colorIndex": 3
  }
]
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-aggregate` | `count` `sum` `mean` `min` `max` `distinct` | `count` | count \| sum \| mean \| min \| max \| distinct, per value |
| `data-axis-label` | text |  | y-axis caption (shown when set) |
| `data-bands` | text |  | a number segment-field cut at these edges, "0,20,40" — a histogram |
| `data-bucket` | `day` `month` `year` |  |  |
| `data-field` | text |  | the number that aggregate reads |
| `data-legend` | `horizontal` `vertical` |  |  |
| `data-max` | number |  | explicit y-max (else derived from the data) |
| `data-over-field` | text |  |  |
| `data-segment-field` | text |  | ASKED of its provider: one bar per value of this field |
| `data-ticks` | number | `4` | number of y gridlines/values |
| `data-where` | text |  |  |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `bar-click` | `{ index: number; label: string; value: number }` |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `heading` | text | heading above the chart |
| `legend` | legend | a &lt;[sherpa-chart-legend](sherpa-chart-legend.md)> for the series. |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`axis-label`, `bar`, `bar-label`, `bars`, `figure`, `gridlines`, `header`, `plot`, `tip`, `x-axis`, `y-axis`, `zero-line`
